reason: A race's own components carry nothing a label reads: its ability scores come from SelectableRaceStat or its heritage selection, and its traits are features it grants, each summarized apart.
text: A heritage, picked with the race, sets its ability scores (the classic one: +2 Strength and +2 Wisdom, -2 Charisma). Resistance 5 to acid, +1 to the DC of its acid spells, +2 on Perception, and 10 feet slower.
